title: GraphDeltaEvent
description: SSE payload sent to subscribed clients after a delta is applied. schema_version is locked at 1; bump when breaking changes are made.

schema_version.description: Bump this when making breaking changes to event shape

sequence_number.description: Monotonic per (story_id, branch_id), assigned by EventBroadcaster. Resets on backend restart (acceptable in v1).

applied_ops.description: The DeltaOps from GraphDelta that were applied — enough to mutate client-side graph without re-fetching.
